class.name: BehaviorTreeTimeout
class.brief_description: Fails and aborts a long-running behavior tree task at a simulation-time limit.
class.description: The decorator evaluates its child while the elapsed [method BehaviorTreeRunner.tick] delta is strictly less than [member duration]. If the deadline is reached, it returns [constant BehaviorTreeTask.FAILURE] and clears the running child subtree's memory, allowing a reactive parent to choose an alternative behavior. If the child succeeds or fails earlier, its status is returned unchanged and all memory beneath this decorator is cleared. A duration of zero always fails immediately, including for instant-success children. The caller must tick the branch to advance time; these are deterministic simulation seconds, not system-clock or background time. A branch interruption or [method BehaviorTreeRunner.reset] discards elapsed state. A missing child fails safely.

method.name: set_duration
method.description: Sets a finite nonnegative deadline in seconds.

method.name: get_duration
method.description: Returns the simulation-time limit in seconds.

members.member: Deadline in simulated seconds for this occurrence of the wrapped task.
